description: List Multiple Award Schedule contract holders for a given SIN (Special Item Number), optionally narrowed by a keyword matched against contractor name, contract number, city, or state. Returns each holder's contract number, phone, and location. Use gsa_schedule_search first to find a valid schedule/SIN pair.

keyword.description: Optional filter against contractor name, contract number, city, or state

schedule.description: Schedule/GWAC number the SIN belongs to (default "MAS")

name: gsa_schedule_contract_holders
title: Gsa Schedule Contract Holders
